name: local-merge
description: Local Merge proactive AI miniapp for conversation insights

scripts.dev:local: bun run backend:dev:local & bun run miniapp:dev; wait
scripts.dev:doppler: doppler run --project local-merge --config dev --preserve-env -- env PORT=3123 bun run backend:dev:local & bun run miniapp:dev; wait
scripts.backend:dev:doppler: doppler run --project local-merge --config dev --preserve-env -- env PORT=3123 bun run backend:dev:local
scripts.miniapp:pack: cd miniapp && rm -f build/com.mentra.local-merge-0.1.6.zip && bun ../node_modules/.bin/mentra-miniapp pack --no-build
scripts.pack: bun run miniapp:build && bun run miniapp:pack
